title: SEO content: keyword to published post

keywords.label: One keyword, or a path to a keyword list

min_score.label: Audit score needed before you are asked to publish

steps.title: Pick the keyword
steps.prompt: Keywords: {{inputs.keywords}}. Site pages: {{run.dir}}/site-crawl.json. Pick the one keyword the site has no page for yet and can rank for. Write {{run.dir}}/plan.md with four lines starting search: that read the top results for it. Set keyword to the pick.

steps.title: Write the SERP brief
steps.prompt: Keyword: {{steps.pick.outputs.keyword}}. Top results: {{run.dir}}/serp/. Write {{run.dir}}/brief.md: the format that wins, typical length and headings, and what none of them cover.

steps.title: Outline the post
steps.prompt: From {{run.dir}}/brief.md write {{run.dir}}/outline.md in the winning format plus the gap nobody covers.

steps.title: Draft the post
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/post.md from {{run.dir}}/outline.md in the voice of the pages in {{run.dir}}/site-crawl.json: first-hand detail, real numbers with their source, short stories. No filler.

steps.title: Add links, images and FAQ
steps.prompt: Edit {{run.dir}}/post.md in place: add 3 to 6 internal links to real pages from {{run.dir}}/site-crawl.json, an image brief with alt text for each image, and an FAQ of the questions the top results leave open.

steps.title: Score the post
steps.prompt: Score {{run.dir}}/post.md from 0 to 100 on intent match, originality, experience signals and on-page SEO for {{steps.pick.outputs.keyword}}. Write the reasons in {{run.dir}}/audit.md. Set document to the post path, score to an object with score (the total), threshold ({{inputs.min_score}}) and parts (points per part), and passed to true when the total reaches the threshold.

steps.title: Write the JSON-LD
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/schema.json: Article and FAQPage JSON-LD for {{run.dir}}/post.md, with only facts the post states.

steps.title: Approve publishing
steps.gate_summary: Post: {{run.dir}}/post.md for {{steps.pick.outputs.keyword}}. Audit passed: {{steps.audit.outputs.passed}} (see {{run.dir}}/audit.md). Approve to publish it on {{inputs.site}} and request indexing.

steps.title: Publish and request indexing
steps.prompt: Publish {{run.dir}}/post.md with {{run.dir}}/schema.json on {{inputs.site}} through its CMS, then request indexing for the new URL. Set url to the live URL.
